biotools.summary: The Copernicus Drought Observatory provides data and maps for monitoring agricultural drought in Europe, using the Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) based on precipitation, soil moisture, and radiation anomalies. Users can access the data through a web portal with interactive map viewers and downloadable datasets.
